reason: A read-only DeepSeek Harness input enhancement that provides searchable, hierarchical file selection and inserts selected relative paths using @ references.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 输入框提供可搜索、可逐级浏览的工作目录文件选择面板，并将选中文件的相对路径以 @ 引用形式回填。
summaries.en: Adds a searchable, hierarchical file picker to the DeepSeek Harness input box and inserts selected working-directory files as @ relative-path references.

capabilities: Browses and searches files within the session working directory
Reads session log headers to resolve the working directory
Reads file metadata including relative paths, sizes, and modification times
Provides a local API for file listing and search
Inserts selected relative file paths into the chat input
